item.title: [Yocto-MX93] 1. Building imx-image-full for the FRDM-i.MX93
item.description: In the Yocto series for the Beaglebone Black and STM32MP157 I did a lot of basic features, how to use yocto, working up from core-image-minimal. This time I build the features for the FRDM i.MX93 board starting straight from the vendor's full image.
